channels.name: Google/Bing organic search
channels.next_proof: Original GSC query/page impressions, real organic sessions, usable published homeowner service pages
channels.scope: Existing first-party properties only; avoid doorway and scaled low-value ZIP pages

channels.name: Earned homeowner publisher placements
channels.next_proof: Verified partner's audience and written permission for accurate editorial reference
channels.scope: Earned placements only; negotiated commissions become performance-paid, not free

channels.name: YouTube helpful videos and Shorts
channels.next_proof: Viewer geography, link clicks, landing sessions and downstream call events
channels.scope: Repair/cost explainer, contractor selection, official safety guidance

channels.name: Relevant homeowner forums and local community contribution
channels.next_proof: Community rules and useful, allowed non-promotional participation
channels.scope: Do not scrape users, auto-post, DM, masquerade as contractor or spam

channels.name: Consent-based newsletter and word-of-mouth referrals
channels.next_proof: Subscriber opt-in and unsubscribe provenance; publication rights
channels.scope: No purchased contact lists or unsolicited homeowner messages

channels.name: Nextdoor local business page and organic posts
channels.next_proof: Genuine local business identity, local posting rights and approved buyer traffic source
channels.scope: Free page/posts only for qualifying local provider; Empire cannot claim to be roofer

channels.name: Pinterest organic roof-repair guidance
channels.next_proof: Organic pin outbound clicks and first-party source attribution

channels.name: Google Search responsive ads with call assets
channels.next_proof: Actual geo-specific CPC, paid click-to-call, accepted Ringba call rate, refund and cost per settled call
channels.scope: Call-only format deprecated; responsive search ads with call assets

channels.name: Microsoft/Bing Search Ads with call extensions
channels.next_proof: Real CPC, eligible geography, buyer-approved hours and phone tracking outcomes
channels.scope: Search call extensions supported; advertiser rules apply

channels.name: Meta Facebook/Instagram phone-call ads
channels.next_proof: Measured eligible calls from creative, geography and delivery hours; genuine buyer-accepted disposition
channels.scope: Calls and form lead products are distinct; never mark form submission as payable call

channels.name: Nextdoor local business ads
channels.next_proof: Legitimate local advertiser identity, geographic scope and buyer approval before any spend
channels.scope: Not a compliant lead-broker shortcut unless advertiser eligibility confirmed

channels.name: Approved publisher traffic partnerships / CPL inventory
channels.next_proof: Signed source rights, allowed methods, consent, payable definition, exclusivity, reversals and price cap
channels.scope: Performance-based does not make traffic free; no auto-sourcing without terms

channels.name: Pinterest consideration or leads ads
channels.next_proof: Measurable outbound clicks, on-site call-start and accepted paid outcome
channels.scope: Typically mid-funnel roof inspiration; benchmark only after high-intent channels

channels.name: Reddit lead-generation advertising
channels.next_proof: Real first-party eligible lead-to-call conversion, accepted outcomes, cost
channels.scope: Reddit currently documents lead campaigns linked to website conversion events; not guaranteed phone-call ad objective

channels.name: Google Local Services Ads
channels.next_proof: Not applicable to Empire lead resale; only legitimate eligible service provider may advertise for own fulfilment
channels.scope: Google policy expressly prohibits lead selling and routing to unrelated companies
